|typespecialist=Ice |trainerclass = Angie's Right Hand |affiliation=Church of Theolia |aliases=Angie's dog}}Cera is [[Angie]]'s personal servant. She is rather rude and incompetent at times but ultimately lives to serve her master in the best way she can. __TOC__ __forcetoc__ ==Appearance== In most of her appearances, Cera has black hair with a jewel shaped hair clipper on the right side of her hair, she possess bangs that swoop to the side of her hair. She wears a maiden dress with a red apron and collar, her skirt is black and frilled and she has a red bow on her back. She wears black leggings with red shoes ==Personality== Much like her master, she is short tempered, ruthless, rude and reckless. She is often incompetent and fails at capturing the protagonist or Erin numerous times. Despite this, she is very loyal to her cause and will do anything to fulfill her master Angie's wishes. ==Biography== Cera first appears alongside Angie observing the protagonist’s group as they fight the Dexoys attacking Terajuma shore. Once [[Melia]], [[Venam]], and the [[protagonist]] make their way to the Church of Theolia, they are met by Cera who revels in [[Angie]]’s frozen magic. Cera then invites the group to see Angie in the next room. In the next room, Cera rebukes the group for disrespecting Angie by not coming straight to the [[Isle of Angels]]. Later at the pinnacle of the [[Tower of Theolia]], Cera tells the protagonist that they’ve pushed Angie to her limit and that she will not listen to reason anymore. Despite this, Cera declares that she will remain faithful to Angie. Much to her regret, she gives the protagonist advice on how to defeat Angie as per Angie’s request. Intent on saving Angie from her defeat, Cera appears with two other maids at [[Keta]]’s house in search of a way to melt NeverMelt-Ice. In the Corrupted Cave in [[Carotos Mountain|Caratos Mountain]], Cera, along with Esther and Deborah, intercept the protagonist and [[Aelita]] while searching for the magma stone. Cera proposes a game to find the magma stone and whichever group finds the stone first gets to keep it. Cera then goes on ahead leaving Deborah to fight the protagonist. Once the protagonist and Aelita catch up to Cera, she admires their determination and declares the start of the race for the magma stone. Later, in the chamber holding the magma stone, Cera rejoices over finally taming the beast that was inside. She rebukes the beast for killing Deborah and Esther and then turns to fight the protagonist and [[Cella|The Eldest]] with the beast which is revealed to be a [[Groudon]]. After defeating the Groudon, Cera expresses disbelief that the protagonist could take it down. The battle causes the magma stone to fall, and the protagonist picks up the stone causing Cera to take The Eldest hostage. Cera demands that the protagonist hand over the magma stone or she will kill The Eldest. If you choose to keep the magma stone, Cera will rush the protagonist and end up breaking the Magma Stone in half and taking a piece of it for herself. Before teleporting away, Cera states that Angie will come for them and that will fall to her Cold Truth. If you choose to hand over the magma stone, Cera will thank the protagonist stating Angie will reward them when she awakens and then she teleports away. Later, after the protagonist wins their ninth gym badge, Cera uses the magma stone to thaw Angie from being trapped in her own ice. In welcoming Angie back, Cera angers Angie by dismissing her question. After finally answering Angie’s question, Cera reaffirms her loyalty to Angie, and they leave [[Kristiline Town|Kristline Town]] together after emerging from the dimensional rift. In [[Grand Dream City]], Cera makes a brief appearance in one of the apartments. She calls the protagonist a pest and states that they will see each other again soon before teleporting off. Much later, while [[Erin]] and [[Kanon]] search for the Diamond Component in Angie’s mansion, Cera discovers [[Alexandra]] and [[Damien]] frozen in the courtyard. When Angie believes that there are two more people snooping about the castle, Cera offers to snuff them out herself, but Angie dismisses the idea believing they will reveal themselves. Cera greets Erin and Kanon when they make their way to the courtyard and forces Erin and Kanon into a game of hide and seek. If they find her, Cera will give them the key to the main hall. From there, Cera teleports into the castle’s cellar. After Cera leaves, Erin ponders that Cera looks familiar and Kanon states that she has a likeness to The Eldest. Upon completing her game, Cera hands Erin the key and expresses curiosity over why Kanon is conflicted with himself. Cera reveals that Angie has taught her Cold Truth and proceeds to use Cold Truth on Kanon with Erin getting caught in the flash. From there, Cera seeks to find out herself why Kanon is so conflicted as a servant. After Erin saves Kanon and escapes from the Cold Truth, Cera calls Erin a demon and claims that Angie’s rage will be greater than how she reacted to Melia. After getting dropped by Erin, Angie appears and berates Cera for her failures to which Cera asks for forgiveness and returns to Angie’s throne room. In the throne room, Cera appears alongside Angie as Erin and Kanon confront them. She also fights with Angie against Erin. After being defeated, Angie freezes Cera after being outsmarted by Kanon. Soon after, Cera disappears along with Angie when a shadow appears from Angie knocks out Erin, Kanon, Alexandra, and Damien. ==Pokémon== Story Mode= === Garufa Ruins === Cera is battled on the [[Corrupted Cave]] field in Single Battle format.
